newsitem.title: UK: UK RPI to benefit from soft output prices - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: UK RPI to benefit from soft output prices - Treasury.

text.p: The UK Treasury said on Thursday Britain continues to achieve the best inflation performance for 30 years and high street prices would soon feel the effect of factory gate prices at 30-year lows.

"We are continuing to achieve the best inflation performance in 30 years and inflation on the high street should soon benefit further from factory gate inflation at 30-year lows," said Angela Knight, financial secretary to the Treasury, in a statement.
Retail prices rose 0.1 percent in November for a year-on-year rise of 2.7 percent, unchanged from October.
Underlying inflation rose 3.3 percent in the year to October, also unchanged from October.
The government's target for underlying inflation is 2.5 percent.
